hints.tr: `text.split()` her türlü boşluktan böler ve boş parçaları atar.
hints.en: `text.split()` splits at every kind of space and drops empty pieces.
Join the pieces with one space: `" ".join(...)`.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

```python
def collapse_spaces(text):
    return " ".join(text.split())

print(collapse_spaces("too   many    spaces"))
print(collapse_spaces("tab\there\nand a new line"))
print(collapse_spaces("   edges   "))
```
hints.en:
The full solution:

```python
def collapse_spaces(text):
    return " ".join(text.split())

print(collapse_spaces("too   many    spaces"))
print(collapse_spaces("tab\there\nand a new line"))
print(collapse_spaces("   edges   "))
```
